rationale.org-governance: Proposes identifiers, monitoring, and logs for broad agent accountability.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Monitoring uses rule violations, caps, and thresholds to flag activity.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Agent cards and logs make agent behavior understandable to overseers.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Monitoring detects permission violations, anomalies, and unintended agent behavior.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent activity logs support audits, attribution, and post-incident forensics.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Measures support regulators, legal mandates, standards, liability, and audit evidence.
